mA.text:
CONTENT MODEL (A)
Sky: breadcrumb; name (5 words); key + vendor code (16); one-liner (18); facts grain, cadence, units, history, lag (14 each); asset strip.
Topsoil: chart heading (10); caption with dataset, unit, aggregation, sign rule (40); chart + key; What it is (60); How it's used 2-3 x 14.
Bronze: note (30), vendor request, gridflow commands.
Silver: relation + schema class (25); schema (14 per meaning); sample DataFrame.
Gold: note (35); notebook with the exact call.
Deep: caveats up to 3 x 25; related up to 4 x 12; footer.
Stratum margin labels (6 words).

mB.text:
CONTENT MODEL (B)
Band: breadcrumb; mono key; vendor code + name; title (5); one-liner (20).
Fact rail, stays level (20 per value): grain, cadence, history with coverage strip, lag, units, rows, silver table, workbench call.
Chart + key + caption (60).
What it is (60). How it's used 3 x 16. Caveats 3 x 30 (above schema).
Reference rows: schema (lineage folded), sample rows, how to get it (notebook cells, endpoint, CLI), related.
Deep footer.
Auth dropped: not established.

mC.text:
CONTENT MODEL (C)
Sky: vendor back-link; h1 (6); id line; one-liner (25).
Plate (first screen, full width): title (9); note with dataset, unit, window, aggregation (55); labels on the series.
What it is (60). How it's used 3 x 18.
Facts 6 pairs x 15 ('not established' printed). Caveats up to 3 x 40, beside facts.
Bronze: raw endpoint + CLI. Silver: schema (15 per row) + sample rows. Gold: workbench call (40).
Deep: related, footer.
Phone needs its own plate (labels to a list).

mD.text:
CONTENT MODEL (D)
Hero: breadcrumb; name (5); code + key; one-liner (20).
Annotated notebook, notes level with cells:
[1] exact call + one proven check, beside What it is (60).
[2] rows = the sample, beside Facts: grain, cadence, stored, published, units (15 each).
fuelhh only: band-mapping cell + note (60).
Chart cell, beside caption (50) + 3 caveats x 35.
How it's used 3 x 20. Schema card (12 per column, outside the notebook). Endpoint + CLI (25). Related up to 4 x 12. Footer.

mE.text:
CONTENT MODEL (E)
First screen (ends by ~890 px): breadcrumb; title (6); key; one-liner (20).
Figure in a fixed 800x272 frame: title (10), caption (40).
Key facts: same 7 rows every page (8 words each; 'not established' kept).
How to get it: workbench call, silver relation, vendor endpoint (16 each), keyed gold/silver/bronze.
Below the fold, strict order: What it is (60); How it's used 3 x (4 + 16); schema (lineage grouped); sample (8 rows x 7 cols); caveats up to 3 x 32; related up to 4 x 12.
CLI cut (belongs on the vendor page).
